BUCKET.ADVANCE.summary: Advances a cursor to fetch or process the next batch of documents.
BUCKET.ADVANCE.complexity: Depends on the query plan of the cursor. O(N) where N is the number of documents the plan scans for this batch.

oneOf.description: The next batch of a QUERY cursor.

cursor_id.description: The cursor ID for the next BUCKET.ADVANCE. -1 means the LIMIT was reached and the cursor no longer exists.

entries.description: The matching documents. Each document includes its _id field.

items.description: A document encoded as BSON bytes or a JSON string. The encoding follows the session's reply_type attribute.

oneOf.description: The next batch of a DELETE or UPDATE cursor.

cursor_id.description: The cursor ID for the next BUCKET.ADVANCE. -1 means the LIMIT was reached and the cursor no longer exists.

object_ids.description: The ids of the affected documents.

items.description: A document id. The encoding follows the session's object_id_format attribute: 12 raw bytes or 24 hex characters.

arguments.name: operation
arguments.summary: The operation the cursor belongs to.

arguments.name: cursor-id
arguments.summary: The cursor id returned by the command that opened the cursor.
